title: Authorize prefix DAO advertisements
description: Bind end-to-end authenticated DAO origins to prefixes they may advertise. Reject unauthorized /0, foreign host routes, and undelegated broad prefixes before any route/replay mutation. Depends on provenance work and prefix semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Root validates authenticated origin and delegated prefix policy before mutation; self /128, delegated prefixes, foreign prefixes, and /0 have literal allow/deny tests across implementations.
close_reason: decomposed: spec 8.7/8.7.1/8.7.2 pins the policy; origin auth + self-/128 + /0 + foreign-route rejections verified present in Rust/Python via new allow/deny matrix test (rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs, 1 test/4 rows, fmt+clippy clean, validated against HEAD 439c12e041 worktree); C root ingest is fail-open (no origin binding, authenticated=true hardcoded) and the Rust delegation gate exists only as another session's uncommitted non-compiling routing.rs work - filed as children worker6-zemq (C, P1), worker6-i3m9 (Rust, P1), worker6-a5yl (Python, P2), worker6-kwa3 (delivery, P2), worker6-iq6t (vectors, P2). Full evidence in assessment comment.
